source: The #1 hit in a particular region reflects the broader cultural edges of the USA’s geography, which has 5 different #1 songs.
claim: Using the story's cut of more than 4 cities and more than 4% of US cities, five songs qualify as US #1 songs: good 4 u (236 cities, 30.9%), Butter (217, 28.4%), RAPSTAR (71, 9.3%), MONTERO (Call Me By Your Name) (67, 8.8%) and Outside (Better Days) (43, 5.6%).
